summary: Forearm bones (r_forearm, l_forearm) hold significant mid-body weight while both shins carry large rotmag, causing arm-pump motion to laterally shear the torso/waist region and producing shard-fan tearing at the mid band.
defects: r_forearm owns 8.7% of mid-band weight (baseline: 0%) with rotmag not listed but upper-band r_forearm=0.402 confirms high arm influence bleeds into mid; arm swing pulls waist verts sideways
l_forearm owns 6.7% of mid-band weight (baseline: 4.3% — doubled share) compounding bilateral forearm drag on torso

l_shin weight asymmetry in lower band: production l_shin=0.270 vs baseline 0.127 (+112%), while r_shin stays near baseline (0.417 vs 0.413) — one-sided shin over-influence suggests left-leg bone mapping error from anatomical_weight_fix.mjs

mid-band hips share collapsed from baseline 0.425 → 0.213 (halved); weight displaced onto spine_01 (0.347 vs baseline 0.184) and forearms, indicating the rig profile re-mapped mid verts away from hips toward arm bones
r_thigh almost absent in lower band (0.003 vs baseline 0.032) while l_thigh is present at 0.080 — asymmetric thigh coverage will cause right-leg geometry to lag/drag during the stride cycle
l_toe lower-band share near-zero (0.023) vs baseline (0.000 expected, but r_toe=0.042 vs baseline 0.177 shows toe weights broadly suppressed — foot plant fidelity lost)
proposed_fix: Audit humans_rig_profile.json bone-to-Y-band assignments: r_forearm and l_forearm are being accepted as mid-band influences — clamp their mid-band weight contribution to 0 by adding them to the arm_only exclusion list in the profile. Separately, re-run anatomical_weight_fix.mjs with symmetric left/right shin normalization (l_shin target share ~0.127, matching baseline) — the current run appears to have over-assigned left shin. Finally, restore hips dominance in the mid band by raising its floor clamp to ≥0.35 in the profile so displaced weight returns to hips rather than spine_01 or arm bones.
